status: PC ADAPTATION (WFC versus maps ship no bot nav; reconstructed from collision_pawn.glb)
units: gltf: metres, Y-up (Rebuild runtime space); ue: centimetres, Z-up
schema_reference: Escalation NavigationCell (_Edges{Start, End, Normal, Neighbor, Border}); RE MP note addendum 1

step_m.source: CONFIRMED (RE): MaxStepHeight 35 + MAXSTEPHEIGHTFUDGE 2 UU = step-up / step-down snap; neighbour cells may additionally rise by CELL * tan(slope) on walkable ramps

min_radius_m.source: polygons keep cells whose clearance >= this (Rebuild robot radii 1.40-2.00 m); --min-radius overrides (diagnostics)

clearance_bands_m.source: cells merge only within one band [<1.5, 1.5-2.5, 2.5-4.5, >=4.5 m] so clearance_m / clearance_max_m filter chassis radii and the 4.4 m vehicle radius

vehicle_radius_m.source: CONFIRMED: versus TnReachSpec CollisionRadius 440 cm (RE mp_navigation_audit). Vehicles move by RB hover physics, not walker rules (RE, HIGH): vehicle_capable is a clearance flag only, a separate vehicle layer

jump_up_max_m.source: CONFIRMED: jump apex = acrobatics JumpHeight (max over chassis, cm; RE: MaxJumpHeight = JumpHeight, frame-rate independent); per-chassis values in chassis_jump

double_jump_up_max_m.source: CONFIRMED authored: JumpHeight + DoubleJumpHeight (max over chassis, cm); per-chassis values in chassis_jump. Links with jump_up_max < rise <= this are kind double_jump_up

max_drop_m.source: CONFIRMED (RE): robot MovementCapabilities.MaxFallHeight 3400 UU (AI / pathing limit)

merge_dh_m.source: tool parameter: max height spread inside one polygon

region_margin_xz_m.source: working-set guard: geometry farther than this outside the anchors XZ bounds is not rasterised

region_margin_y_m.source: working-set guard: vertical margin around the anchors height range

cover_low_m.source: PROVISIONAL cover hint thresholds (no cover system in WFC versus data)

pawn_JumpZ_note.source: TnPlayerPawn.JumpZ is NOT the jump used in MP (RE: JumpZ derived from JumpHeight, sqrt(2*2940*500) = 1714.6)
